## Summary of Expertise
Noureddine Driouech is a Moroccan Software Engineer specializing in:
1. **Generative AI, Local RAG & LLMs**: Architecting private, offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using open-weights models (Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace), vector databases (FAISS, Chroma DB), and LangChain/LlamaIndex with zero data leakage.
2. **Modern Full-Stack & SaaS Platforms**: Engineering high-performance web applications using React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, and PostgreSQL.
3. **Cross-Platform Mobile Development**: Building fluid iOS & Android mobile applications using React Native, Expo, and Figma design systems.
4. **High-Throughput Web Automation & Scraping**: Developing resilient ETL scraping pipelines with Python, Selenium, and Scrapy processing 50,000+ records monthly with 92% CAPTCHA resolution accuracy.
